summary: AMI has partnered with Fujitsu to serve as the firmware supplier and development partner for Fujitsu's FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU. This next-generation Arm-based CPU is designed for AI, HPC, and hybrid workloads, emphasizing exceptional power efficiency, advanced security, and reliability for sustainable data centers. This collaboration leverages AMI's decades of firmware expertise to advance Fujitsu's commitment to greener computing.

title: Temasek, Nvidia part of group buying $51.8 billion AI data centre operator in record-breaking deal - The Straits Times
summary: An investor group including Temasek, BlackRock, Microsoft, and Nvidia is acquiring Aligned Data Centers for US$40 billion (S$51.8 billion), marking the largest-ever data centre transaction. This acquisition aims to secure computing capacity for the surging demand in artificial intelligence. The deal highlights the critical need for AI infrastructure and significant investment from major tech players.

title: Meta Platforms to use Arm’s energy-efficient Neoverse GPUs for some AI workloads - SiliconANGLE
summary: Meta Platforms will utilize Arm's energy-efficient Neoverse GPUs for AI workloads, specifically for search ranking and recommendation systems. This partnership highlights Arm's expanding role in the AI industry, leveraging its chips' power efficiency, while Meta continues to significantly expand its data center infrastructure to support growing AI service demands with projects like "Prometheus" and "Hyperion" across the U.S.
